name: Areas ~Koi Suru Otome no 3H~
source:
This is the after spin-off from Areas and is a love story about maidens, for maidens. Konoka and Ryiz both love Yuuya very much and one day confessed to him at the same time. As rivals in love, they were always around him, joining the same clubs as him, and making bentou for him. Suddenly appeared a quiet and refined girl, and he began to take an interest in her.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/03/08/march-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
本作是《Areas》的后日谈外传，也是一段献给少女、关于少女的爱情故事。木花与Ryiz都非常爱悠也，某天还同时向他告白。作为情敌，两人总是围在他身边，加入与他相同的社团，还替他制作便当。此时，一名安静而端庄的少女突然出现，悠也开始对她产生兴趣。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/03/08/march-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
